data.name: Sound event when note
data.value: Animations: the event plays in them, when an attack, hit or death starts, at each step of a walk and at the end of each loop of stop1 and stop2. Each frame in: each frame the monster is drawn in one of them; the chance draws each frame. Once until it stands: the first frame the monster is drawn in one of them; then no once event of the set plays until it is drawn in stop1, stop2 or walk. Cues: in the frames of a cue of the monster's model. Each frame in a cue: each frame the monster is drawn in the frames of a cue of its model. Timers: a drawn frame where a timer of the monster's model ticks. Moments: where the game plays them, whatever the animation: attack and hit when they start, death when it starts (also in Chaos Castle), stand when the monster is set to stand (a walk ends, the server stops it), walk at each step. An event names animations, each frame, once, cues, each frame in cues, timers or moments.

data.value: Sounds the map's objects make while they are drawn, played as the original client played them. An entry names its maps: maps with the same objects share it.

data.name: Add a sound to an object type
data.value: Add a sound to an object type

data.name: No object of this map makes a sound
data.value: No object of this map makes a sound.

data.name: Pick an object in the world
data.value: Pick an object in the world

data.name: Click an object in the world
data.value: Click an object in the world...

data.name: While in view note
data.value: Each frame an object of the type is drawn, a channel that has ended starts again and a playing one is left alone; a copy plays quieter the farther its object is from the hero.

data.name: Any object note
data.value: Plays while any object of the entry's maps is drawn: a sound of the whole map (a hum), at full volume.

data.name: Sound editor note
data.value: Every sound the game loads: the code's (Data/Audio/SoundFiles.json), the monster sound sets' (Data/Monsters/Sounds.json) and the map object sounds (Data/Maps/ObjectSounds.json). A name, file, channels or 3D changed here reaches the game at once; Save writes the files that changed. Files are picked from Data/Sound, which is never changed.

data.name: Sound editor events note
data.value: Which sound the game plays when (Data/Audio/SoundEvents.json): for each event, the first rule that matches plays one of its sounds, picked at random when there are more. An empty field matches anything. Changes reach the game at once; Save writes the file.

data.name: Sound event hero footstep
data.value: Your footsteps (each step of a walk, not while flying)

data.name: Sound event interface click
data.value: A click on a button, by the click kind its theme gives it (click-sound)

data.name: Sound event character selected
data.value: A click on a character in the character select scene

data.name: Sound event kinds tip
data.value: The click kinds this rule plays for, as the themes give them to buttons (click-sound: confirm). The themes use confirm, cancel, select and menu. Empty: any kind.

data.name: Sound event player attack swing
data.value: A player's swing at the start of an attack

data.name: Sound event numbers not read {0} {1}
data.value: Not changed: {0} takes whole numbers from 0 to {1}, one or a range, between commas (7, 24-29).

data.name: Sound event kinds not read
data.value: Not changed: click kinds are lower-case letters, digits and -, between commas (confirm, cancel).

data.name: Sound event worlds tip
data.value: The worlds it plays on, by number: "7, 24-29, 36". Empty: any.

data.name: Sound event tiles tip
data.value: The hero's ground tiles, by number: "0-2, 4-9". Empty: any.

data.name: Sound event plays tip
data.value: Pick the sounds: one plays, at random when there are more.

data.name: Sound editor remove folder tip
data.value: Removes the folder; its folders and sounds move up into its parent.

data.name: Sound editor drag tip
data.value: Drag a sound by its id onto a folder.

data.name: Sound editor type tip
data.value: The type a sound of the code counts as when nothing names its source or place: a sound of the server's messages, say. Who plays it still decides first.

data.name: Sound editor channels tip
data.value: Channels: how many copies of the sound play at once (1 to 4).

data.name: Sound editor 3D tip
data.value: Placed in 3D at the object it plays at.

data.name: Sound editor play tip
data.value: Plays the file once at full volume; the Sound Mixer does not change it. Greyed out when the file is not in the client folder.

data.name: Sound editor pick tip
data.value: Pick another file from Data/Sound; play one first with its play button.

data.name: Sound editor missing file
data.value: The file is not in the client folder: the sound is silent.

data.name: Sound editor shared file
data.value: Another sound of the code loads this file too.

data.name: Sound editor played not loaded
data.value: The game played this sound, but nothing loads it: it is silent.

data.name: Sound editor step refused
data.value: This step's sound changed in another window since; it stays as it is.

data.name: Sound editor folders unreadable {0}
data.value: The folders' file could not be read, so the folders cannot be changed and Save leaves the file alone. Fix it, then Revert reads it again. {0}

data.name: Sound editor read files again tip
data.value: Lists the sound files of Data/Sound again, for the file picker and the rows' missing files. The editor reads the folder once, when it first needs it, so a file copied in since counts after this.

data.name: Sound editor gone sounds {0}
data.value: {0} folder entries name sounds that are gone: removed in another window, or by hand in the file.

data.name: Sound editor drop gone sounds tip
data.value: Takes them out of the folders, as a step that Undo puts back.

data.name: Sound mixer reset all tip
data.value: Unmutes, unsolos and turns every kind and sound back to full volume.

data.name: Sound mixer note
data.value: For listening in the editor: mute, solo and turn down types of sounds and every sound heard. Changes apply at once; a muted loop keeps running silently. The game's own volumes stay as they are, the editor's Play buttons and previews are not affected, and every start plays everything as normal.

data.name: Sound mixer show in world tip
data.value: Marks where the sounds of the rows shown come from: a map object with its rings of full volume (3 tiles) and of its quietest (15 tiles, dashed), a monster with its 5-tile hearing ring (solid while you are inside it), and where the game's own code plays a sound (a hollow marker: a character, an NPC, an effect, an item, a creature). A source flashes when one of its sounds starts; the sounds without a place (the interface, ambience, music) are logged at the top left. Hover a row to highlight its sources; the Show boxes pick the types.

data.name: Sound mixer copy named tip {0} {1}
data.value: #{0}, {1}, click to copy the file name

data.name: Sound mixer copy music tip
data.value: A music track, click to copy its file name

data.name: Sound mixer show tip
data.value: Off: Show in world draws nothing of the type (no markers, rings, flashes or log lines); it is still heard.

data.name: Sound mixer clear all tip
data.value: Empties the list and counts again from 0. Muted, solo and lowered sounds are put back to normal; the types above stay as they are.

data.name: The values the {0} numbers of {1} share
data.value: The values the {0} numbers of {1} share

data.name: Shared value locked
data.value: Shared by the monster's numbers: change it on the monster's row, or make it this number's own (right click).

data.name: Monster row note
data.value: A monster with several numbers: its row changes the values they share.

data.name: Add number note
data.value: The new number gets the values the monster's numbers share, and no maps.

data.name: Copy number note {0}
data.value: A copy of {0} in the same monster, with its values but no maps.

data.name: Move number note
data.value: Its values stay: those the monster has too become shared, the others its own.
